summary: Synthetic full conversation with strong PPP, diagnosis, BANT, three-pillar pitch, and clean ask.

turns.text: Alex speaking. What is this about?

We have helped 14 manufacturers find avoidable energy costs. By the end of this call, we can determine whether there is a useful savings case. First I will ask a few questions, then outline the three requirements, and we can decide if it is a fit or not. Fair?
What prompted you to look at this now, and what outcome are you trying to reach?
Our bill rose 30% and our last audit produced no action. We need a board plan this quarter.

So it sounds like costs are rising, you need an approved plan this quarter, and the gap is turning audit data into action. Have I got that right? What have you tried since that audit, and what is another quarter of delay costing?
Yes. We tried supplier quotes. Delay is about £20,000. Finance and the board approve anything above £10,000.
What budget range can finance support, who besides the board influences approval, which requirement matters most, and when could implementation begin?
Budget is available if payback is under three years. Procurement and estates review it. We can start in October.

The outcome is an investable plan. The bridge has exactly three pillars: verified interval data, site engineering, and a finance case. Your supplier quotes covered price but lacked the other two legs, like a three-legged stool with one leg missing.
That makes sense. What happens next?
Shall we book the paid diagnostic with estates and finance for Tuesday at 10?
